## About

Vanshika Singh Chauhan is a backend developer from Jaipur, India, and a B.Tech Information Technology student at SKIT Jaipur who builds secure, scalable REST APIs and AI-powered applications with Java, Spring Boot and Spring AI.

As a B.Tech IT student at SKIT Jaipur, I'm deeply immersed in backend engineering and algorithmic problem-solving. My journey is fueled by a drive to build scalable, secure systems — from REST APIs to AI-powered assistants using Spring Boot and Spring AI.

Beyond backend work, I'm a competitive programmer with 550+ solved problems across LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, CodeChef, and Codeforces. I qualified Smart India Hackathon 2025 (Round 1) and constantly push myself through weekly contests to sharpen my problem-solving edge.
